description: Source code for the TrafficSeparationManager class managing traffic separation policies, ports, and configurations in a network device.

classes.name: TrafficSeparationManager
classes.description: Manages traffic separation policies, ports, and configurations in a network device.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the traffic separation manager with given settings.

methods.name: add_trunk_port
methods.description: Adds a trunk port to be managed and applies policies if active.

methods.name: remove_trunk_port
methods.description: Removes a trunk port from management and clears policies if active.

methods.name: add_access_port
methods.description: Adds an access port to be managed and applies policies if active.

methods.name: remove_access_port
methods.description: Removes an access port from management and clears policies if active.

methods.name: apply_policies
methods.description: Applies traffic separation policies to all managed ports.

methods.name: clear_policies
methods.description: Clears traffic separation policies from all managed ports.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the traffic separation manager, removing all ports and configurations.
